BiblicalUsage: Jehotsadak is Jehozadak, an Israelite, the father of Joshua the high priest. In 1 Chronicles 6:14, Seraiah begat Jehozadak. The fuller story is told on the Jehozadak profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jehozadak belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
